Kate (CSM): FYI — Orion Labs QBR scheduled for 2026-04-02. I need the cost/forecast section finalized by Tue. Can we do a short handoff here?
Asha (CS Ops): I can pull token export + onboarding status. Current notes: onboarding 3/4 milestones done, cache only on search route, embeddings batching not enabled yet.
Ibrahim (FP&A): Please include last 90 days by week + a 3-scenario forecast (baseline/growth/spike). I can turn that into a one-pager with charts.
Tom R. (SRE): Noted. Also worth calling out the two recent spike events (03/10 & 03/18) — both correlated with a retry storm from their beta. We throttled at 90rps which cut tail latencies but didn't prevent duplicate token generation.
Kate (CSM): Good call. Need concrete optimization asks we can present: caching, batching, quota alerts, reserved capacity recommendation.
Asha (CS Ops): Quick numbers: last 30 days total tokens ~ 72M; avg tokens/day 2.4M; median request length 420 tokens. Spike day 03/18 = 5.9M tokens. If we enable prefix KV cache for the chat system they use, conservative estimate ~20-28% token reduction on median traffic.
Ibrahim (FP&A): If we model 25% savings on median, that turns into ~$14k/mo saved at current pricing. Can you confirm current model & quantization profile?
Asha (CS Ops): They're on rdx-meduim-1 (quantized int8) via hosted API. We can propose: enable batching for embeddings (batch size 64), enable prefix caching (6h TTL), and a canary for Dedicated during peak windows.
Tom R. (SRE): Canary note: Dedicated for peak 6pm-10pm PT M-F would add ~6k/mo commit but would reduce retries and duplicate tokens. Ops tradeoff documented.
Ibrahim (FP&A): Sounds reasonable. I can sketch baseline/growth/spike numbers if you share daily token CSV.
Asha (CS Ops): Uploading CSV now -> https://redwood.internal/dash/exports/1769951234-orion.csv :eyes:
devex-bot: New dashboard export ready: https://console.redwood/invoices/exports/1769951234-orion.csv (expires in 7 days)
Kate (CSM): Thanks. Two things for QBR slide: 1) Proposed ops changes + expected $ impact, 2) Risk note: renewal at end of Q3 — if spikes continue they may request a discount. Need to show mitigation plan.
Tom R. (SRE): For the slide, add a small runbook snippet (for on-call) to flip prefix cache TTL and scale dedicated windows. Example CLI:
```
# enable prefix cache route
redwood cache enable --org Orion --route /chat --ttl 6h
# schedule dedicated window
redwood dedicate schedule --org Orion --window "18:00-22:00" --days Mon-Fri --gpu p4d.24
```
Asha (CS Ops): Also propose budget alert thresholds: warn @cs-team at 70% of committed monthly, page @ibrahim at 90%. Example alert rule: `monthly_spend >= 0.7 * committed && current_day_of_month >= 7`
Ibrahim (FP&A): Agree. Force escalation at 95% to finance inbox + account lead.
Kate (CSM): Action items: Asha — produce the 3-scenario CSV + one-line assumptions by EOD Monday. Ibrahim — finalize dollarized forecast and slide. Tom — confirm dedicated cost calc & runbook excerpt. I'll draft the QBR slide deck and sync Wed 9am PT.
Asha (CS Ops): On it. I'll also capture customer feedback bits about hallucination on search (they blame long contexts) — may justify cache + shorter context policy.
Tom R. (SRE): +1. Will include p99 latency impact estimates.
Ibrahim (FP&A): Will prepare the one-pager with bar chart and waterfall showing current vs optimized spend.
Kate (CSM): Perfect. If anyone spots other items to call out (security, SLO regressions), drop them here. :thumbsup:
